# PONZI

> Change detection on Sentinel-1 SAR coherence time series: forecast the coherence of each new acquisition per burst, score the drop, calibrate it to p-values, date the changes as events. Four repositories: ponzi-core (computing), ponzi-service (server, worker, client), ponzi-visual (map front end), ponzi-suite (this site).

Agents use PONZI through ponzi-client when a server is running (client mode), else through the ponzi-core commands and `ponzi-worker run` on the machine (local mode), never submitting cluster jobs. Agents change PONZI's code only under a signed-off change request, and do not commit or access clusters without the owner's approval.
